items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: And Karla was singing background. So I was like wow, cool. But we went on and we rehearsed and we played the gig

ctx.x: “Sailing,” and “Say You’ll Be Mine” and all those tunes. And I was kind of like wow, this is cool. And then she said, “oh and I want you to meet another friend of mine, Karla Bonoff.” And Karla was singing background. So I was like wow, cool. But we went on and we rehearsed and we played the gig and I didn’t think a thing of it. You know? That was it. And then maybe several months later I come home one day and I check the machine and it’s like, “um this is Mike MacDonald, Christopher Cross suggested I should call…
So you did some rehearsing with him or did you just like do gigs?
